entries.name: --ec-backdrop-opacity
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the opacity of the overlay behind the settings drawer (0.4 light, 0.6 dark) is a platform value the book does not set. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.name: --ec-border-status-bar
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the status bar border is transparent in light and the border colour in dark, and the book defines no hairline colour. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.name: --ec-color-accent
entries.reason: Set at runtime from the system accent: ThemeContext.tsx calls getAccentColor(), with ACCENT_COLOR_FALLBACK #007AFF at src/domain/accent_color.ts, so the accent remains platform-owned. v5.1 keeps raw accent for the toggle-on track, the light focus/drop indicators and other existing platform uses; only the dark segmented-focus outline and active drop-zone border use the separately mapped platform-indicator mix. Accent is never text. The custom ::selection rule is removed so the operating system owns selection colors.

entries.name: --ec-color-action-hover
entries.rule: Filled-action hover state overlay: light Steady Teal #0F766E under Deep Teal at alpha 0.08 gives #0F7069; dark Seafoam #5EEAD4 under Clean White at alpha 0.12 gives #71EDD9.

entries.name: --ec-color-action-pressed
entries.rule: Pressed filled-action state applies the existing theme overlay twice: light Steady Teal resolves to #0F6B64; dark Seafoam resolves to #82EFDE.

entries.name: --ec-color-border
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the book defines no hairline colour. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.name: --ec-color-error
entries.reason: Platform red on icons only (D-04). v5.1 changes the app value #c44536 (the same in both theme blocks, tokens.css:14 and tokens.css:92) to the platform reds per theme and moves error text to the primary text colour, which clears the error-as-text entries 74-04 seals. 74-04 seals no error-icon entry: #c44536 measures 4.56:1 on the light ground #f5f6f8, 4.16:1 on the light surface #e8ecf0, 3.72:1 on the dark ground #141416 and 3.44:1 on the dark surface #1c1c1f (floored), so the icon passes 3:1 on today's grounds in both themes.

entries.name: --ec-color-error-bg
entries.rule: error rows sit on the raised surface step; the error is carried by the platform-red icon and primary-text message (D-04, D-13)

entries.name: --ec-color-platform-indicator
entries.reason: The v5.1 platform-owned indicator role has no brand equivalent. Light resolves to the raw runtime --ec-color-accent. Dark resolves only to exactly color-mix(in srgb, var(--ec-color-accent) 90%, CanvasText 10%). The role has exactly two consumers: .segmented-control__segment:focus-visible outline and .drop-zone--active border; toggle-on, all other accents and every light indicator stay raw accent. Fresh real Storybook boundary probes pass at 3:1 or greater on both sides of drop and focus boundaries in both themes.

entries.name: --ec-color-surface-hover
entries.rule: The token values are the existing one-pass state overlay on each raised surface: Rinse under Deep Teal at alpha 0.08 gives #DCE6E5; Tide under Clean White at alpha 0.12 gives #2E5753.

entries.name: --ec-color-surface-pressed
entries.rule: The token values are the existing two-pass state overlay on each raised surface: Rinse under Deep Teal at alpha 0.08 gives #CBD7D6; Tide under Clean White at alpha 0.12 gives #476B68.

entries.name: --ec-duration-fast
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book gives no hover, pressed or focus feedback duration; the app keeps 150ms (tokens.css:67), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records it.

entries.name: --ec-duration-normal
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book's reveal is about 200 ms and it publishes no duration token; the app keeps 200ms for settle (tokens.css:68), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records it.

entries.name: --ec-duration-slow
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book gives no drawer duration; the app keeps 300ms for the settings drawer only (D-14, tokens.css:69), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records it.

entries.name: --ec-ease-out
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book asks for an ordinary ease-out and publishes no curve value; the spec uses the CSS keyword ease-out, which replaces this app cubic-bezier (D-14, tokens.css:65), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book records the keyword.

entries.name: --ec-ease-spring
entries.reason: Retired (D-14): the cubic-bezier overshoots and the brand says nothing bounces in the product; its uses move to the ordinary ease-out.

entries.name: --ec-font-family
entries.reason: System sans stack (D-08, tokens.css:53): BRAND.md says that inside the app the interface keeps the system font, so ExifCleaner feels native; no font file is bundled.

entries.name: --ec-font-family-mono
entries.reason: System monospace stack (D-08, tokens.css:55): BRAND.md permits Geist Mono or the system monospace and the app keeps the system one; no font file is bundled.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-body
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book's type rows are marketing-sized and set no app UI scale; the app keeps 16px for body text (D-09), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts an app scale.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-heading
entries.reason: Retired (D-09): declared at tokens.css:60 (24px) and read by no stylesheet or component; v5.1 reintroduces a heading size only if it needs one.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-label
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book sets no app UI scale; today's token is 20px (tokens.css:59, read at settings_drawer.css:71), which the spec calls the title size (D-09) because the name clashes with the 12px Label role, so v5.1 renames it, and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts an app scale.

entries.name: --ec-font-size-small
entries.owner: exifcleaner-brand, decided at the v5.1 discuss-phase
entries.decision: The book's type rows are marketing-sized and set no app UI scale; the app keeps 14px as the default UI size (D-09), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts an app scale.

entries.decision: The book sets weights per role (Data 400, Label 600) and publishes no weight tokens; the app keeps regular 400 (tokens.css:61), and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts weight tokens.

entries.name: --ec-font-weight-semibold

entries.name: --ec-line-height-normal
entries.reason: Declared in no stylesheet: file_table.css:139 reads var(--ec-line-height-normal), so the line-height declaration is invalid at computed-value time; v5.1 replaces it with unitless --ec-line-height-* tokens (D-09).

entries.name: --ec-segment-index
entries.reason: Set inline per control at SegmentedControl.tsx from the active option index; a runtime value tokens.css never declares (RTL-01).

entries.name: --ec-shadow-drawer
entries.reason: No brand equivalent (D-04): the book separates surfaces by colour and gives no UI shadow value. The platform values are kept, and 74-04 exempts this token from the contrast test with a written reason, so it carries no sealed entry.

entries.decision: The brand book sets no app spacing (BRAND.md Layout leaves the scale to the platform); the app keeps 4px on its 4 px-base scale, and the v5.1 discuss-phase decides whether the book adopts the scale.

entries.name: --ec-stagger-delay
entries.reason: Set inline per row at FileRow.tsx:119 ("--ec-stagger-delay": staggerIndex * 30 ms) and read at file_table.css:182 (animation-delay: var(--ec-stagger-delay, 0ms)); a runtime value that tokens.css never declares. v5.2 removes the stagger.

entries.name: --ec-toggle-off-track
entries.reason: Platform-owned role with no brand equivalent (D-04). Both theme blocks use exactly color-mix(in srgb, GrayText 90%, CanvasText 10%). Fresh real ToggleSwitch Off observations match independent GrayText, CanvasText and mix probes; track-to-ground, track-to-raised-surface and white-thumb ratios are all at least 3:1 in light and dark. The real opaque thumb is pinned Clean White #FFFFFF; the near-white identity mutation is rejected even when contrast still passes.

entries.name: --empty-state-button-pressed-surface
entries.reason: Component-scoped alias used by the existing EmptyState primary action: it selects --ec-color-action-pressed for the primary variant and --ec-color-surface-pressed for the secondary variant; both values remain mapped semantic roles.

entries.name: --spacing-md
entries.reason: Declared nowhere: error_boundary.css and file_list.css read var(--spacing-md) and every use resolves to nothing; v5.1 maps each use onto a --ec-space-* step (D-11).
